info.description: API Design First spec for onboarding self-introduction API.

request.description:
### Get Onboarding Introduction

取得新進成員的自我介紹資訊。

#### Endpoint

GET /onboarding/{newbie_name}

#### Path Parameters

- `newbie_name` (string, required)  
    新進成員名稱，例如 `vincent`
    

#### Response

- 200 OK：成功回傳自我介紹內容
    
- 404 Not Found：查無此成員

response.name: Introduction
